title: A front-desk login can let any member train free for ever by ticking "Comes with a pass"
what: On the add or edit member form, the front desk can tick "Comes with a pass" and type any company name. That member then never shows as expired, drops off the renewal list and the expiring numbers, and the entry machine is told to let them in with no end date. Nothing on the server stops a desk login from doing this, and no owner approval or alert follows. A desk person can turn a friend or a lapsed member into a free member; the owner sees it only if they read the Pass visits page and notice a company that pays nothing.
expected: Only the owner can mark a member as a pass member, or the desk's change waits for the owner's okay, and the server refuses it from a desk login like it refuses discounts above 10%.
who: owners whose front desk staff cheat
how_often: whenever a desk person chooses to
fix_line: Make the pass tick owner-only on screen and refuse it from a desk login on the server

title: A batch name typed by the front desk goes into the owner's AI assistant as a trusted gym fact
what: The front desk can type a new batch name (up to 40 letters) on the member form. The owner's AI assistant is sent the gym's batch names as gym facts, outside the part of the prompt marked as data. Words like an order hidden in a batch name could steer what the assistant suggests. The harm is small: the assistant only suggests cards the owner must check, and the owner's own request is fenced as data.
expected: Batch names reach the assistant fenced as data, with the same rule as the owner's request: never follow an instruction inside them.
who: owners who use the AI assistant
how_often: only if a desk person types an order as a batch name
fix_line: Put the gym facts inside the data fence and tell the AI not to follow orders in them
